Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Ignore all curved arrows. Scan the drawing for actual atom-atom bond lines: count the X–X bond at the top, the R–C single bond in the acyl/carboxylate fragment, the C=O double bond as one displayed bond, and the C–O single bond to O−. Do not count Ag+ because no bond line connects it, and do not count charges or arrows. Total = 4.

再推理：按题意和方法草案，忽略所有弯曲箭头、 charges 和没有键线连接的 Ag+。逐项计数实际原子-原子键线：X–X 键 1 个；R–C 单键 1 个；C=O 双键作为一个显示的键连接计 1 个；C–O 单键 1 个。总数为 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4。
